transcriptScript.speaker: agent
transcriptScript.text: Hi Priya, this is Aarav from HDFC Collections. This call is recorded for quality. How can I help you today?

transcriptScript.speaker: customer
transcriptScript.text: Yes hi. I paid 15,000 rupees on the 12th but your system is still showing it as unpaid. I've been going in circles with the bot.

transcriptScript.speaker: agent
transcriptScript.text: I understand, that's frustrating. Let me pull up your account — can you confirm the last 4 digits of your registered mobile?

transcriptScript.speaker: system
transcriptScript.text: Identity verified · OTP not required (voice-match confidence 94%)

transcriptScript.speaker: agent
transcriptScript.text: Thanks. I can see a payment attempt on the 12th but it looks like it failed at the gateway — no debit on your side. Do you have a UTR or bank reference?

transcriptScript.speaker: customer
transcriptScript.text: Wait, so I was not actually charged? Let me check my statement… hmm, yeah nothing on my side either.

transcriptScript.speaker: agent
transcriptScript.text: Right — good news, no money was lost. I can raise a formal dispute closure note and, if you'd like, set up a fresh payment right now for 15,000 or your full overdue of 12,180.

transcriptScript.speaker: customer
transcriptScript.text: Okay yes let's do the 12,180 today, and I'll clear the rest by month end.

transcriptScript.speaker: agent
transcriptScript.text: Perfect. I'm capturing a Promise-to-Pay: 12,180 now, remainder by 31 July. You'll get an SMS link in a minute.

transcriptScript.speaker: customer
transcriptScript.text: Great, thank you for actually helping.

suggestions.title: Acknowledge & de-escalate
suggestions.body: I understand this has been frustrating — let me pull up your account right away and get this sorted.

suggestions.title: Explain failed-gateway status
suggestions.body: Our records show a gateway failure on 12 Jul — no amount was actually debited from your account. Could you share a UTR if you have one?

suggestions.title: Offer PTP + waiver check
suggestions.body: You're eligible for a one-time late-fee waiver of ₹450 if we clear the overdue EMI today. Shall I apply it?

suggestions.title: Capture Promise-to-Pay
suggestions.body: I'll record a Promise-to-Pay: ₹12,180 today + ₹36,540 by 31 Jul. You'll receive a secure payment link on WhatsApp.
